llm.summary: The email skill is mostly transparent, but its optional watcher can expose raw mailbox credentials to a spawned OpenClaw process and has some local file-safety weaknesses.

dimensions.detail: email-watch-lite.js imports the IMAP module, which loads email secrets into process.env, then passes the full environment to spawned openclaw commands; this is broader than needed and not clearly disclosed.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation uses npm registry dependencies without install hooks, but setup.sh writes plaintext mailbox credentials by shell redirection before chmod and does not defend against preexisting symlinks at the credential path.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are scoped to email use, require approval for real outbound sends, warn against auto-replies, document credential loading, and label the watcher as optional and higher-trust.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No system service, cron job, or startup persistence is installed, but the optional watcher writes a state file under the workspace/memory path and can trigger a local OpenClaw agent to analyze pending emails and forward summaries.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The core purpose is coherent: the artifacts implement IMAP inbox reading/search/fetch/download, SMTP sending with attachments, contact lookup, sent-copy behavior, and an optional watcher, all matching the stated email-tool purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review before installing if this mailbox is sensitive. The basic IMAP/SMTP functions are purpose-aligned, but avoid enabling the optional watcher unless you trust the spawned OpenClaw environment with mailbox credentials. Use an app-specific password, restrict allowed read/write directories, avoid symlinks in those directories, and run setup only in a trusted local account.
llm.findings:
[TP4] expected: Downgraded: after full local inspection, the package does include both IMAP and SMTP scripts plus the watcher, and SKILL.md documents mark-read/mark-unread, contacts, replies, sent copies, and attachment behavior.
[AE1] unexpected: Not accepted as evasion: scripts/imap.js, scripts/smtp.js, and scripts/email-watch-lite.js were present in the workspace and inspected directly.
[T05] unexpected: Accepted: the optional watcher invokes openclaw with env: process.env after email credentials are loaded into the process environment, exposing raw IMAP/SMTP credentials and unrelated inherited secrets to the child process.
[T09] unexpected: Accepted in part: attachment downloads are intended, but the write-path allowlist can be bypassed under local symlinked-ancestor conditions when the requested output directory does not yet exist.
[T09] unexpected: Accepted in part: setup.sh stores credentials in the expected location, but creates/truncates the secret file non-atomically before chmod and follows symlinks.
